info.title: FieldLoop internal mock CMMS
info.description: Synthetic read-only simulator endpoint from architecture section 4.2. Not a web-api/BFF endpoint. Run behind Cloud Run invoker IAM in dev/demo; local fixtures need no credentials. No real CMMS connector or publication.

get.description: Return four deterministic synthetic work orders, or open preventive work due at or before asOf when pmDue=true. Data is fixed for fieldloop-demo/DL-01; no source write, database, publisher or remote IO. This bounded internal fixture list is not the paginated public platform list API.

parameters.name: pmDue
parameters.description: Only open preventive work due at or before asOf.

parameters.name: asOf
parameters.description: Timezone-aware simulation clock, not wall time. Default is fixed for deterministic replay.

400.description: Invalid query; code validation_failed, input values are not echoed.

405.description: Only GET is allowed; code validation_failed. No state mutation.

serviceIdentity.description: Verified by Cloud Run invoker IAM, not proxy headers. The handler does not implement browser auth or independently validate IAM.
